new_page.description: Scottsdale, North Delta houses for sale: 53 listed in September 2026, monthly sales and how Scottsdale compares with North Delta. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Scottsdale Houses for Sale | North Delta Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Scottsdale. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Scottsdale, North Delta: 53 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 10 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 2 of 4 North Delta communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Scottsdale fell from 54 in June to 53 in September (−1.9%), and 30 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 25.4% of North Delta’s 209 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Scottsdale?
Scottsdale also had 24 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in September, against 53 houses listed. The Scottsdale condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Scottsdale home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

66 houses sold in Scottsdale with a median price of $1,227,500 (the middle half sold between $1,096,250 and $1,368,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 95.7% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $514 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 6,822 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Scottsdale?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 53 houses listed in Scottsdale. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Scottsdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Scottsdale had a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Scottsdale from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 30 houses sold in Scottsdale over those 4 months, out of 116 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Scottsdale?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Scottsdale sell for?
faq.a: 66 houses sold in Scottsdale between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,227,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Scottsdale?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.7% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
